careers.name: AI Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and deploys artificial intelligence systems and neural networks to solve complex problems and automate intelligent workflows.
responsibilities: Develop deep learning models and fine-tune large language models
Implement end-to-end AI pipelines from data preprocessing to inference
Optimize neural network architectures for latency and memory constraints
Integrate AI services into production applications with robust APIs

careers.name: Software Developer
careers.description: Architects and implements high-quality computer software, desktop tools, and distributed application systems.
responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following SOLID principles
Design scalable application architecture and database schemas
Perform unit testing, code reviews, and automated testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver software features

careers.name: Backend Developer
careers.description: Builds server-side logic, data storage architectures, high-throughput microservices, and secure APIs powering modern applications.
responsibilities: Develop robust RESTful and GraphQL APIs for client applications
Design, optimize, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases
Implement authentication, authorization, caching, and rate limiting
Ensure server-side scalability, reliability, and security

careers.name: Frontend Developer
careers.description: Creates responsive, accessible, interactive user interfaces and client-side applications with modern web standards and design systems.
responsibilities: Build rich, responsive, and cross-browser compatible user interfaces
Translate UI/UX wireframes and mockups into pixel-perfect web components
Manage complex client-side state and integrate asynchronous backend APIs
Optimize web performance, Core Web Vitals, and accessibility

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.description: Applies statistical modeling, machine learning, and exploratory data analysis to discover patterns and guide strategic decision-making.
responsibilities: Extract, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data from diverse sources
Formulate hypotheses and conduct rigorous statistical hypothesis testing
Train predictive machine learning models and evaluate performance metrics
Communicate insights and business recommendations through dashboards and presentations

careers.name: Cybersecurity Engineer
careers.description: Protects networks, computer systems, and sensitive data from cyber threats, vulnerabilities, intrusions, and security breaches.
responsibilities: Conduct penetration testing, code security reviews, and vulnerability scans
Implement robust firewalls, encryption mechanisms, and identity management
Monitor intrusion detection systems and manage incident response procedures
Ensure organizational compliance with security standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2)

careers.name: Cloud Engineer
careers.description: Architects, provisions, and manages scalable, highly available, and cost-optimized infrastructure on modern cloud platforms.
responsibilities: Design multi-tier and fault-tolerant cloud architectures on AWS/Azure/GCP
Automate cloud resource provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
Configure VPCs, subnets, load balancers, and security groups
Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, reliability, and billing expenditure

careers.name: DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Bridges the gap between software development and IT operations through continuous integration, delivery pipelines, and automated monitoring.
responsibilities: Build and optimize automated CI/CD deployment pipelines
Orchestrate containerized microservices using Kubernetes and Docker
Maintain system uptime, observability, logging, and alerting systems
Automate infrastructure provisioning and release management processes

careers.name: Mobile Developer
careers.description: Develops native and cross-platform mobile applications with fluid user interfaces and seamless hardware integration.
responsibilities: Create responsive, fluid, and robust mobile applications for Android & iOS
Integrate native device sensors, camera, GPS, and local SQLite storage
Implement state management architectures (Bloc, Riverpod, Provider)
Deploy and maintain mobile applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store

careers.name: Full Stack Developer
careers.description: Master of both frontend user interfaces and backend server architectures, delivering complete end-to-end web applications.
responsibilities: Develop interactive frontend components and connect them to backend microservices
Design database schemas, write SQL queries, and implement ORM models
Implement end-to-end security, authentication, and error handling
Deploy and maintain full stack web applications on cloud infrastructure

careers.name: Data Analyst
careers.description: Interprets complex datasets, builds executive dashboards, and transforms raw numbers into clear actionable business intelligence.
responsibilities: Write complex SQL queries to extract and aggregate business data
Clean, validate, and structure messy data sets for exploratory analysis
Design intuitive interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI / Tableau
Present analytical findings and KPI trends to business stakeholders

careers.name: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Researches, trains, optimizes, and productionizes scalable machine learning models with automated MLOps pipelines.
responsibilities: Engineer informative features from complex datasets for model training
Implement, evaluate, and benchmark multiple ML algorithms
Package models into scalable inference microservices with REST endpoints
Set up automated model tracking, drift detection, and retraining pipelines

careers.name: QA / Test Automation Engineer
careers.description: Develops automated testing suites, quality frameworks, and continuous validation pipelines to ensure software correctness and reliability.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain automated end-to-end and API testing suites
Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines to validate pull requests
Perform exploratory testing and maintain comprehensive test coverage reports
Identify, isolate, and track software defects with reproducible steps

careers.name: UI/UX Designer
careers.description: Creates user-centric interfaces, intuitive workflows, visual design systems, and interactive prototypes for digital products.
responsibilities: Create wireframes, user journeys, mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma
Conduct user research and usability testing to iterate on product experiences
Develop and maintain accessible design systems and component guidelines
Collaborate with product managers and engineers during design handoff

careers.name: Database Administrator
careers.description: Manages, optimizes, secures, and maintains database management systems ensuring maximum availability, performance, and data integrity.
responsibilities: Install, configure, patch, and monitor database servers and clusters
Implement automated backup, disaster recovery, and data retention policies
Optimize complex SQL queries, index structures, and execution plans
Enforce database role-based access control and data encryption standards

careers.name: Site Reliability Engineer
careers.description: Applies software engineering practices to infrastructure operations, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable observability.
responsibilities: Maintain service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets for production systems
Build automated monitoring, alerting, and telemetry dashboards with Prometheus & Grafana
Participate in on-call rotation, post-mortem root cause analysis, and chaos experiments
Automate infrastructure provisioning and continuous release pipelines

careers.name: Blockchain Developer
careers.description: Designs and develops decentralized applications (dApps), cryptographic protocols, and secure smart contracts on distributed ledgers.
responsibilities: Write and unit test secure Solidity smart contracts for decentralized platforms
Conduct thorough gas optimization and formal security verification audits
Build Web3 frontend interfaces connecting crypto wallets with smart contracts
Implement cryptographic primitives and signature verification routines

careers.name: Game Developer
careers.description: Builds engaging video games, interactive real-time experiences, physics engines, and graphics simulations for consoles, PC, and mobile.
responsibilities: Program gameplay mechanics, character controllers, and state machines
Implement real-time game physics, collision detection, and raycasting
Profile and optimize frame rates, memory footprints, and asset pipelines
Write custom shader programs and visual effects for immersive gameplay

careers.name: Embedded Systems Engineer
careers.description: Develops firmware, device drivers, and real-time software operating closely with microcontrollers and custom electronic hardware.
responsibilities: Write low-level firmware and board support packages in C/C++
Interface sensors and actuators using I2C, SPI, UART, and CAN protocols
Implement deterministic multitasking tasks on Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS)
Debug hardware and timing issues using logic analyzers and oscilloscopes

careers.name: Business Intelligence Analyst
careers.description: Transforms raw enterprise data into actionable business insights, interactive executive dashboards, and strategic performance metrics.
responsibilities: Design interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards tracking core business KPIs
Write complex SQL analytical queries with window functions and aggregations
Build multidimensional star/snowflake data models for BI reporting
Present quantitative data insights to business stakeholders and executive leadership

careers.name: Product Manager (Technical)
careers.description: Bridges engineering, user experience, and business strategy to define product roadmaps, technical requirements, and feature execution.
responsibilities: Author detailed product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories
Prioritize product backlogs using data-driven impact-effort scoring matrices
Coordinate sprint planning, standups, and retrospective meetings with engineering
Analyze product analytics metrics, funnel drop-offs, and user feedback

careers.name: Robotics Engineer
careers.description: Designs, programs, and tests autonomous robotic systems, motion planning algorithms, perception pipelines, and control systems.
responsibilities: Develop ROS nodes for robot perception, localization, and trajectory execution
Simulate robotic kinematics and physics dynamics in Gazebo environment
Implement computer vision algorithms for object recognition and obstacle avoidance
Tune PID and state-space controllers for precision motor actuation

careers.name: Technical Writer
careers.description: Produces clear, comprehensive technical documentation, developer API guides, architecture overviews, and tutorials for software products.
responsibilities: Write and maintain developer-facing REST API reference documentation and guides
Create tutorials, onboarding walkthroughs, and system architecture diagrams
Manage docs-as-code workflows using Git, Markdown, and static site generators
Collaborate with engineers and product teams to clarify complex technical concepts

careers.name: IT Support / Systems Engineer
careers.description: Provides enterprise technical support, manages operating systems, troubleshoots network infrastructure, and administers identity management.
responsibilities: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues for users
Configure user accounts, permissions, and group policies in Active Directory
Deploy, configure, and patch Linux and Windows client and server machines
Automate routine maintenance and backup tasks using Bash and PowerShell scripts
